critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck hump primitive along its longitudinal axis to increase its length by 40% relative to the cockpit's rear edge. Simultaneously, apply a 15-degree taper at the junction where the hump meets the main fuselage cylinder to ensure a smooth transition. Adjust the horizontal width of this primitive to match 85% of the total fuselage diameter, ensuring it integrates as a continuous structural extension rather than a separate bulbous shape.

discrepancies.observed: A short, stubby hump that ends quickly behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively low and rounded.
discrepancies.reference: A more pronounced, elevated profile on the forward section of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical scale of the hump geometry

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears as a separate bulbous shape attached to the top.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous transition from the upper deck into the main fuselage body.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: merge or taper the junction between the hump and the main cylinder

discrepancies.observed: The hump is narrow relative to the total fuselage diameter.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck occupies a wider portion of the forward fuselage cross-section.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase horizontal width of the hump primitive
